description:
Keywords Studios Los Angeles is a premier provider of multimedia content localization and audio production services. From its offices and beautiful on-site recording studio in the heart of Burbank, Keywords Studios Los Angeles collaborates with top-tier streaming platforms, broadcasters, content creators, publishers for the gaming and media & entertainment industries.

We are seeking Subtitling Project Managers to join our Media & Entertainment division. In this role, you will collaborate closely with client tools, workflows, and teams to ensure seamless management of multilingual localization projects. The ideal candidate will excel in file delivery management, overseeing the handoff and delivery of multiple projects of varying scales, all while meeting client-agreed timelines. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for delivering exceptional localization solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the full lifecycle of subtitling projects, from planning and scheduling to execution and delivery.
  • Coordinate with localization specialists to ensure all projects meet deadlines and quality benchmarks.
  • Monitor and track project progress, providing regular updates to stakeholders and identifying any risks or bottlenecks.
  • Develop and implement processes and workflows that optimize efficiency and maintain the highest standards for subtitling quality.
  • Manage relationships with clients and external vendors, collaborate with internal teams, such as colleagues in different offices, to align on project needs and resolve issues.
  • Ensure subtitling follows region-specific guidelines and adheres to cultural sensitivities, compliance laws, and industry best practices.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovations in subtitling and localization.
  • Report on KPIs and project metrics to upper management, proposing solutions for continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Film, Media Studies, Linguistics, or a related field; advanced degrees are a plus.
  • 3+ years of experience in localization, translation, or media production, with a strong focus on subtitling.
  • Proven experience managing complex, large-scale projects with tight deadlines.
  • Strong understanding of subtitling software (OOONA, EZtitles), technologies, and file formats.
  • Knowledge of multiple languages is an advantage, but not required.
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret project data and suggest process improvements.
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., OOONA) and tracking systems.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships and negotiation.
  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Professional growth opportunities
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Dedicated to diversity and inclusion
  • Additional perks: cycle-to-work, IT schemes, pensions, healthcare, social events, and more.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement strategic plans to seed and go to market with new products and technologies.

  • Identifies, researches, evaluates, and prioritizes market leads and opportunities to influence purchases and specifications with key end users and influencers. Forms relationships with potential regional customers outside of the current Company revenue stream.

  • Recommends ongoing improvements to the Market Development and Training & Education program to support regional business; proactively implements new processes and workflows.

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience using skills as a seasoned, experienced professional with a comprehensive technical knowledge of audio principles and products.

  • Extensive experience providing audio technical support, audio design, and audio equipment set-up.

WHO WE ARE

Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Shure is headquartered in the United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

THE MIX MATTERS

Arquiteto de Dados - Curitiba/PR ou São Paulo/SP

Join to apply for the Arquiteto de Dados - Curitiba/PR ou São Paulo/SP role at MadeiraMadeira

Na MadeiraMadeira, temos uma missão clara: incentivar uma cultura orientada a dados, otimizando a descentralização e autonomia de análises, suportando melhores decisões que permitam prover a melhor experiência aos nossos clientes.

A área de dados oferece uma série de oportunidades desafiadoras e emocionantes, especialmente no que diz respeito à arquitetura de dados. Como parte de uma equipe dedicada, você estará envolvido em projetos que visam estruturar, integrar e governar dados de maneira eficiente e inovadora, com o objetivo de impactar diretamente o sucesso da empresa.

A crescente demanda por dados e informações exige arquiteturas escaláveis e flexíveis, e sua missão será criar soluções que garantam a capacidade de lidar com grandes volumes de dados de forma ágil e eficaz. Trabalhar com fontes de dados diversificadas, como sistemas internos, bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, além de APIs e outras plataformas, será uma oportunidade de aplicar e expandir suas habilidades na integração de dados.

A otimização da performance também será uma das suas missões. Ao integrar ferramentas analíticas avançadas, como business intelligence e machine learning, você contribuirá para o design de fluxos de dados que suportem análises em tempo real ou em batches de forma eficiente, sem sobrecarregar o sistema. Aqui, você terá a chance de aplicar suas habilidades em engenharia de dados para criar soluções robustas e de alta performance.

A evolução constante das necessidades do negócio será um estímulo para sua criatividade e inovação. Sua capacidade de adaptar e atualizar a arquitetura de dados para atender às novas demandas, tecnologias e fontes de dados será essencial, garantindo que a empresa esteja sempre à frente das tendências e preparada para o futuro.

Em resumo, a missão na área de dados será desafiadora, mas cheia de oportunidades de crescimento e impacto. Você terá a chance de moldar a arquitetura de dados de forma estratégica, promovendo eficiência, inovação e segurança, e tornando-se uma peça chave para o sucesso da organização. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, em constante evolução e com um grande potencial de impacto, essa é a oportunidade ideal para alavancar sua carreira na área de dados.

Na MadeiraMadeira acreditamos que a base para uma operação eficiente, escalável e orientada a dados é uma arquitetura sólida e moderna. O Arquiteto de Dados será responsável por desenhar, implementar e evoluir uma arquitetura de dados que suporte os desafios de um varejo digital dinâmico e em constante crescimento.

Seu papel será garantir que os dados estejam disponíveis, confiáveis e acessíveis para as áreas de negócio, produto e operações. Você liderará a transformação da infraestrutura de dados, promovendo governança robusta, integração ágil de dados e escalabilidade. O objetivo final é habilitar decisões mais rápidas e assertivas, reduzir perdas operacionais e impulsionar métricas críticas, como aumento do GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) e redução de custos logísticos.

O Que Estamos Procurando

Buscamos um profissional apaixonado por resolver problemas complexos de dados, com experiência em ambientes de alta escala e em iniciativas que conectem tecnologia e estratégia de negócios.

Venha transformar o futuro do e-commerce de casa com a gente.

  • Principais Responsabilidades
    • Planejamento e Implementação da Arquitetura de Dados :
      • Liderar a adoção da arquitetura de dados baseada no modelo Medalhão, habilitando domínios de dados conforme os princípios do Data Mesh.
      • Definir padrões e frameworks para a ingestão, processamento, armazenamento e consumo de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e eficiência.
    • Governança e Qualidade de Dados :
      • Implementar políticas e ferramentas de governança para garantir consistência, segurança e qualidade dos dados.
      • Estabelecer um modelo de single source of truth, minimizando redundâncias e inconsistências.
    • Colaboração Estratégica :
      • Trabalhar em parceria com times de engenharia, ciência de dados, produto e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções arquiteturais.
      • Garantir que a arquitetura de dados apoie iniciativas estratégicas, como personalização, otimização logística e redução de custos operacionais.
    • Inovação e Otimização Contínua :
      • Monitorar tendências e inovações em arquitetura de dados, avaliando tecnologias como data lakes, data warehouses e ferramentas de observabilidade.
      • Otimizar pipelines e fluxos de dados para melhorar desempenho e custo-benefício.
    • Mentoria e Liderança Técnica :
      • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico do time, promovendo boas práticas e cultura de dados.
      • Servir como referência técnica em projetos críticos relacionados à arquitetura de dados.
Principais Ferramentas, Tecnologias e Padrões

O Arquiteto de Dados deve dominar uma ampla gama de ferramentas e tecnologias modernas para projetar e implementar soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio. Isso inclui ferramentas de processamento e orquestração de dados para garantir fluxos de dados automatizados e resilientes. Tecnologias de armazenamento e análise são essenciais para a construção de data lakes e warehouses performáticos. Além disso, o uso de frameworks distribuídos é indispensável para o processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real ou batch.

Em relação aos padrões de mercado, o arquiteto deve ter profundo conhecimento de arquiteturas como Data Lakehouse , Data Mesh , e Lambda/Kappa Architectures , que atendem às necessidades de escalabilidade, descentralização e processamento em tempo real. Domínio em governança e qualidade de dados e confiabilidade dos dados. Além disso, é esperado conhecimento em linguagens de programação bem como proficiência em SQL para modelagem e consulta de dados. Por fim, o entendimento de frameworks de segurança e compliance, como ISO 27001 , LGPD , e GDPR , é fundamental para mitigar riscos e garantir a conformidade regulatória.

Indicadores de Sucesso
  • Redução de inconsistências em dados críticos para abaixo de 5%.

  • Implementação de domínios de dados com uso efetivo em múltiplas áreas de negócio.
  • Redução de custos operacionais relacionados à gestão e integração de dados em 20%.
  • Habilitação de insights que impulsionem GMV e melhorem KPIs de eficiência logística.
Requisitos e Qualificações

title: HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR
description:
HR Business Partner, People Experience and Technology (PXT) - HR

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic people who are passionate about making each day better for all employees — and you will play a crucial role in this journey! Our People eXperience & Technology (PXT - Human Resources) professionals care deeply about the employee experience and support employees and leaders in focusing on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.

Key job responsibilities
In this position, you will be responsible for the entire PXT (People eXperience and Technology - Human Resources) agenda in an Amazon logistics warehouse located in São João de Meriti - RJ. The generalist role in HR will involve managing the mobilization/demobilization of workforce in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to manager levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, operational vacancy fill rates), indirect coordination of chartered transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.

A day in the life
As an HRBP of a "Fulfillment Center - FC", no two days are alike, but a typical day will likely include the following responsibilities:

  1. Work with a team of HR Assistants to create the best experience for employees.
  2. Lead the reporting and analysis of Human Resources metrics and goals ("attendance", "attrition", "fill-rate", delving into root cause analyses and improvement plans).
  3. Participate in "Daily Dive Deep – DDD" meetings along with the Operations team and other support areas.
  4. Co-lead workforce planning meetings, execution of mobilization and demobilization of personnel contingent.
  5. Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes, as well as the work environment and people's needs, on the "shop-floor".
  6. Monitor the environment from a labor and employee relations perspective, identifying trends and risks.
  7. Participate in Brazil PXT Operations team meetings, reporting metrics and indicators of your operation.
  8. Lead PXT and multidisciplinary projects that go beyond your work unit.
  9. Promote and model an inclusive environment for all employees through specific programs, local initiatives, and affinity groups.
  10. Serve as the first point of escalation for employee concerns.
  11. Support employee inquiries and situations with discretion and experience, along with routine standard work on employee onboarding, performance management, engagement processes, and benefits services.
  12. Train, develop, and support leadership through decision-making.
  13. Collaborate with various levels of the organization, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  14. Influence and guide partners to prioritize employee experience and customer obsession.

About the team
We could be a great match if you:
  • Are excited to work in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment.
  • Are enthusiastic about working in a production environment (logistics warehouse) engaging our teams, training our leaders, and creating the best place in the world to work.
  • Are excited about generalist positions where each day you will deal with various Human Resources topics.
  • Are enthusiastic about flexing your routine when necessary, making room to occasionally work night shifts or weekends, in an operation that runs 24/7 every day of the year.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Completed Bachelors Degree
Experience in generalist Human Resources subsystems.
Experience in supporting massive and operational customer groups (factories, warehouses, call centers, etc).
Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (reads and writes easily and fluently, understands ~85% when listening and can provide quick and objective answers).
Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel at an intermediate level (VLOOKUP and pivot tables); BI tools will be a differential.
Must be willing to work 100% on-site at the FC in São João de Meriti-RJ, with flexibility in hours and days, especially during peak periods or promotions (Prime Day, Black Friday).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience in HR for factory/manufacturing, transportation company, distribution center, or logistics.
Masters Degree

title: XP Future 2025 | Transição de Carreira - Espírito Santo
description:
XP Future 2025 | Transição de Carreira - Espírito Santo

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP FUTURE , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Estaremos presencialmente no Espírito Santo para nosso processo seletivo e expandir ainda mais nosso time!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar em nosso Programa de Formação XP Future:

  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros).
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais, mas não eliminatórios:

  • Certificação CPA-20.

Principais desafios da cadeira:

  • Prospecção de novos negócios - poder de originação/novos clientes;
  • Organização para trabalhar diversas frentes em curto período de tempo;
  • Forte poder de persuasão;
  • Empatia e visão de longo prazo;
  • Gestão de carteiras e grandes contas - Pessoa Física e Pessoa Jurídica.

Obs: Contratação CLT

Sobre as etapas do processo seletivo - XP Future 2025 - Espírito Santo

  • Realização da etapa de testes - Fit cultural e PI (Obrigatórios)
  • Bate papo com o time de Expansão;
  • Processo seletivo presencial na cidade;
  • As pessoas candidatas aprovadas em processo seletivo serão admitidas no regime CLT e vão atuar na área do B2C;
  • Após início na XP Inc., os assessores contarão com capacitação teórica, cursos preparatórios e treinamentos para as certificações - CPA-20.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP Vitória ! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Summary
Performs CT scans of designated anatomy using professional judgment while imaging with regard to technical quality according to physician specifications. Provides courteous and professional delivery of CT technical exams and procedures while adhering to radiation safety precautions. Supports patient questions and concerns regarding exam procedures and process, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality regarding PHI and HIPPA related information. On-call as required by the department. Works in a hospital facility that offers full hospital services. Provides direct patient care to high acuity patients encompassing emergency, inpatient and outpatient classes supporting up to and including trauma and ICU.
Job Duties

  • Performs all types of imaging procedures and operates all equipment safely and properly including scanners, injectors, and monitors.
  • Reviews all images of all exams, repeating images as necessary for best possible result.
  • Communicates with the patient by addressing the patient by name, introducing self to the patient, explaining the exam in lay terms and keeping the patient Informed of exam progress.
  • Prepares patient images to PACs for interpretation by a radiologist and administers contrast media per protocol.
  • Completes technical notes, verifies images, and sends exams to PACS promptly.
  • Notifies physician of any adverse reaction to contrast media or change in patient's condition.
  • Reviews patient chart/script prior to initiating exam to verify pertinent information.
  • Prepares patients for CT procedures by accurately assessing patient’s needs, medical history, and provides patient education.
  • Operates computed tomography scanner for data acquisition, reconstruction of images, documentation of images, and performs quality control measures for the purpose of ensuring optimal quality images.
  • Attends department meetings or other mandatory meetings with a positive attitude.
  • Practices accurate and timely completion of scheduled and unscheduled work to maximize productivity.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Technical School Diploma Graduate of accredited Radiography program or equivalent or
  • CNMT, RT(CT) Certified
  • Less than 1 year experience as a Radiologic Technologist
  • Ability to provide proper patient care essential to radiologic procedures.
  • Knowledge and skills to perform scans on patients of all ages, adapting to various protocols.
  • Proficient use of the advanced software for CT scanning and post procedure processing applications.
  • Strong aptitude for CT technology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, positive attitude, and upbeat demeanor.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days

  • CNMT - Certified Nuclear Med Tech NMTCB - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire
  • CT - Computed Tomography ARRT - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year
Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Graduate of Health Science program
  • Knowledge and skills to perform venipuncture.
Physical Demands
Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data and Analytics
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.

You will have the opportunity to make a big impact on our business performance as you support the data strategy and lead the development of custom models/algorithms. Working in close partnership with the business leadership team, you will manage the vision and agenda for business analytics in your area of responsibility.

How you will contribute

  1. Drive the vision and delivery of data-driven products for Mondelez finance following established product management practices.

  2. Prioritize development items according to deadlines, business context, and technical needs.

  3. Advocate for and manage funding, including budgeting, headcount needs, and other costs.

  4. Partner with engineering teams to move finance data products to AI-readiness.

  5. Identify opportunities for efficiency, automation, resilience, and innovation in Mondelez’s data landscape.

  6. Bridge conversations between finance business stakeholders and development teams, leveraging knowledge of both Mondelez business domains and technical expertise.

  7. Think strategically, connecting stakeholder use cases to technology solutions and considering the end-to-end experience.

  8. Deeply understand stakeholder needs, product analytics, and industry innovation to drive the product vision and strategy, maximizing business and customer impact.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • HIGHLY ORGANIZED and able to manage competing priorities across stakeholders.

  • LEADERSHIP SKILLS including a natural ability to make things happen while proactively managing ambiguity, complexity, and interdependencies in an organized and structured way.

  • DESIGN and data visualization experience with Tableau or Power BI.

  • BUSINESS ACUMEN and strong working knowledge of corporate finance.

  • GROWTH/DIGITAL MINDSET and the ability to identify and execute opportunities leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

  • CLOUD EXPERIENCE with data solutions in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • TECHNICAL EXPERTISE in data and analytics, including data warehousing, SQL, machine learning, and familiarity with modern AI techniques.

  • EXPERIENCE with financial systems such as SAP, SAC, and Hyperion is a plus.

  • INTEGRITY and sound judgment in all decisions and interactions, aligned with our values, policies, and external regulations.

More about this role

We recognize our role as transformation agents to generate positive change, prioritizing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We aim to break stereotypes and barriers to ensure societal representation within our company. Our Diversity Committee operates on four fronts: People with disabilities (PCD), Ethnic-Racial, Women, and LGBTQIAP+, and we are part of MOVER – Movimento pela Equidade Racial.

What you need to know about this position:

As Senior Product Manager for Financial Data & Analytics, you will oversee the development and execution of our financial data products roadmap. Using a mix of technical knowledge and business acumen, you will help Mondelez’s Finance organization build data and analytics products aimed at an AI-ready future. Your products will serve decision-makers at the highest levels, improving measurement and insight through Mondelez’s data. As demand for data and insights grows within Mondelez, your contribution will foster the delivery of timely, relevant, and accurate insights to teams that need them.

What extra ingredients you will bring:

Preferred Experience:

  • Management consulting experience is a plus.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or corporate finance departments.
  • Experience with GenAI applications and LLMs.

Travel requirements:

  • Limited travel up to 20% of the time.

Mondelez International values the well-being of our people and offers flexible work arrangements, including hybrid models with remote work options on certain days.

No relocation support is available.

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez Brasil is the company's fourth-largest operation worldwide, with approximately 7,500 employees. We produce, sell, and distribute beloved brands such as Oreo, Lacta, Trident, and many more, in Brazil. Our products are available in over 700,000 points of sale and in more than 92% of Brazilian homes. Our factories are located in Vitória de Santo Antão and Curitiba, and we operate one of the company's 11 global technology centers, dedicated to R&D.

Mondelez International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Senso de dono / urgência

Orientação ao cliente

MISSÃO DO PAPEL

Realizar o controle total da utilização, solicitação e liberação dos EPI´s na unidade de negócio em que está alocado; cumprir e fazer cumprir as NR’s de segurança do trabalho; atuar no suporte a liderança em todos os processos que envolvem a área de segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente; realizar o processo de eleições para CIPATR e demais assuntos relacionados, posicionando o gestor sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e/ou dúvidas; fazer, se necessário, inspeção em documentos de empresas e colaboradores terceirizados; solicitar suporte ao técnico de segurança com maior experiência na área; trabalhar em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa.

  • Licenças Ambientais: Suporte a Analista Ambiental nas pontas, acompanhamento das renovações, dúvidas com órgãos locais, envio dos documentos para lançamento;
  • Acidentes: Criação dos alertas de acidentes, realização dos comunicados, investigação do acidente, acompanhamento das ações, acompanhamento do acidentado, informação a liderança;
  • Sistema de SST (SOC): Lançamento dos acidentes, lançamento das avaliações, realização do PGR e emissão das OS e Fichas de EPI;
  • Inspeções de Segurança (Check List Fácil): Inspeção de Segurança e Ambiental em todas as lojas, silos e escritórios a cada 2 meses, gestão das ações, acompanhamento junto às áreas operacionais e direcionamento;
  • Programas, Laudos e E-Social: Gestão dos vencimentos nas lojas (PGR, LTCAT, LIP), realização das avaliações ambientais (ruído, poeira, vibração), gestão das ações e saídas dos programas, envio dos documentos para SOC e E-social;
  • Segurança das Lojas, Armazéns e Silos: Inspeção bimestral em todas as lojas, armazéns e silos, revisão das análises de risco junto aos times, realização e acompanhamento das permissões de trabalho, suporte geral à operação;

  • Treinamentos de SSMA: Realização de treinamentos (altura, espaço confinado, EPI, integração, OS, segurança com químicos, etc.), lançamento dos certificados no sistema e gestão de vencimentos;

  • Processos de CIPA: Organização conforme norma, definição de quadro obrigatório, processo eleitoral, coleta das assinaturas, arquivamento, gestão das estabilidades e reuniões com cipeiros;
  • Processos de Brigada de Emergência: Organização conforme norma, definição de quadro obrigatório, treinamento do time, gestão dos certificados, arquivamento e realização das reuniões com brigadistas;
  • Segurança com terceiros: Avaliação dos documentos dos terceiros (treinamentos, exames etc.), realização de inspeções nas frentes de trabalho, emissão das permissões para o trabalho quando aplicável, realização de integração.

We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!

At Azion you will have the opportunity to develop and be connected to cutting-edge technology, immersed in a culture centered on innovation and a high-performance team, unlocking new possibilities and working with the future of technology.

About The Position

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at our São Paulo/SP office. As part of the Engineering department, the selected candidate will be responsible for developing highly concurrent systems in Rust, optimizing performance, distributed caching, and connection management to handle thousands of requests per second with low latency.

  • Concurrent and Asynchronous Programming: Implement highly concurrent systems in Rust, leveraging async/await and efficient thread management to handle thousands of requests per second;
  • Performance Optimization: Optimize system resource usage, including memory management and throughput maximization, ensuring low latency even under high load;
  • Distributed Caching Management: Develop and maintain efficient caching systems across a globally distributed network, addressing challenges such as consistency and cache invalidation;
  • Upstream Connection Management: Maintain stable and efficient connections with upstream services, including load balancing, automatic reconnections, and backpressure management in large-scale network communication.

Requirements

  • Experience in systems development with Rust and low-level programming;
  • Understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS;
  • Familiarity with secure development practices;
  • Familiarity with Linux and operating systems;
  • Knowledge of version control (Git);
  • Background in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Knowledge of CI/CD and automation pipelines;

Differentials

  • Experience with Edge/CDN;
  • Experience with TCP sockets and Unix sockets;
  • Familiarity with Internet protocol RFCs;
  • Knowledge of HTTP proxy cache daemons such as Nginx, Caddy, and Envoy;

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on-site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

About Experian


Experian é uma empresa global de dados e tecnologia, que impulsiona oportunidades para pessoas e empresas ao redor do mundo. Ajudamos a redefinir práticas de empréstimo, identificar e prevenir fraudes, simplificar o setor de saúde, criar soluções de marketing e obter insights mais profundos sobre o mercado automotivo, tudo usando nossa combinação única de dados, análises e software. Também ajudamos milhões de pessoas a alcançar seus objetivos financeiros e a economizar tempo e dinheiro.

Operamos em diversos mercados, desde serviços financeiros até saúde, automotivo, agronegócio, seguros e muitos outros segmentos industriais.

Investimos em pessoas e novas tecnologias avançadas para desbloquear o poder dos dados. Como uma empresa do índice FTSE 100 listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN), temos uma equipe de 22.500 pessoas em 32 países. Nossa sede corporativa fica em Dublin, Irlanda. Saiba mais em experianplc.com.

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Experiência na gestão de produtos;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Iniciativa, liderança e senso crítico para tomar decisões de negócio, resolver problemas e entregar valor ao cliente;

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir a visão estratégica das soluções de crédito e aprimorar a jornada dos produtos;
  • Traduzir desafios e oportunidades em soluções, sugerindo novos modelos de negócio e serviços;
  • Inovar o portfólio atendendo às tendências do mercado de crédito, promovendo disrupções em soluções segmentadas;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida do produto, incluindo planos de descontinuidade quando necessário;

Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região Sudeste. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial no Rio de Janeiro e proximidades.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.

Your Career

Palo Alto Networks is scaling its world-class strategy organization and looking for Team Manager in the area of security services. Though our security services are successful both in the market as well as at preventing attackers, the landscape is continually changing and in need of innovation leadership. The Palo Alto Networks Strategy function is a focused team that works on our most mission-critical business challenges to drive and support our industry-leading growth.

As a Manager, of the renewals Team, your efforts will directly impact the overall strategy and success of a world-leading cybersecurity business. You will collaborate on complex business and technology problems that are top-of-mind for our executives, particularly as those relate to key partnerships having strategic value to the business. You will lead initiatives with stakeholders to formulate mutually beneficial and measurable outcomes for technical and business objectives with strategic partners. You possess a unique blend of business insight, business strategy experience, big-picture thinking, influencing skills and ability to collaborate with a large number of constituents within Palo Alto Networks.

Your Impact

  • Manage the overall day to day renewal operations of assigned direct reportsand districts / regions in the LATAM regions
  • Motivate your direct reports to drive pipeline development and revenues through renewal sales efforts leveraging the partner network
  • Ability to accurately forecast to leadership teams and drive a committed number on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis to SR. Manager and VP
  • Coaching and development of subordinates, bi-weekly 121's
  • Supervise and assist direct reports on large deals through to completion
  • Evaluate, and document, yourdirect reports based on Key Metrics and goals set by Leadership
  • Monitor the outbound efforts of assigned you renewals reps by tracking and reporting weekly activities
  • Collaborate with Sales Leaders to identify strategies to achieve sales goals and uncover new, high value opportunities alongside renewals
  • Provide accurate, ongoing reporting through the continuous update and maintenance of necessary reports in Salesforce.com and other tools and applications
  • Provide support for renewal escalations and your assigned districts

Your Experience

  • At least 3+years experience in Managing diverse enterprise renewals /sales teams
  • At least 3+ years experience in leading 8-15 people, in the office and remote work environments
  • At least 3+ years Experience in hiring, developing and retaining talent
  • Proven Experience with channel /partner sales models renewals/ upsells
  • Proven to consistently achieve renewal/ sales team goals through your leadership
  • Proven ability to learn new technology quickly, as well as adapt to changing needs
  • Excellent communication skills -the ability to build cross-functional relationships
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills -the ability to work on many projects concurrently
  • Excellent Microsoft Excel, Google Suite and Salesforce.com skills

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

You will be part of an international team, leading the development of 1GLOBAL's entitlement server platform. We are looking for a developer to join the team, working collaboratively to design and implement new services, maintain existing components, and test our applications.
We run a multi-site platform, following strict security requirements, provide the service to customers around the world and manage millions of subscriber profiles. We embrace a highly collaborative and diverse environment, value teamwork, autonomy and hold ourselves accountable for our deliverables and customer success.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-impact features and contribute to the architecture design, focusing on resilience, scalability, security, and fault tolerance;
  • Advocate for high code quality, readability, and extensive test coverage;
  • Promote best practices for a high-traffic web (or mobile) environment;
  • Work with Agile methodology;
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and promote these improvements through seamless integrations, documenting solutions and new workflows;
  • Mentor junior team members when necessary and contribute to meaningful code reviews.
  • 2+ years of experience in software development (primarily with Golang);
  • Experience with unit, integration, and E2E testing (test-driven development is a plus);
  • Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming interfaces;
  • Familiarity with relational databases, CI/CD workflows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes;
  • Familiarity with development tools and processes;
  • Understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure;
  • Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with an autonomous and motivated mindset.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

  • Demais atividades pertinentes a função.

  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento de aplicações modernas (APIs) e websites/plataformas;
  • Experiência com Java 11+/Spring Boot, Angular 15+;
  • Experiência com Teste unitário (JUnit + Mockito);
  • Experiência com Banco da dados (MongoDB/DocumentDB e MySQL);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de mensageria e eventos - RabbitMQ e Kafka;
  • Conhecimento dos principais modelos e padrões de arquitetura de aplicações – DDD, BDD, Microfrontends, Design Patterns, SOLID, Service Mesh, Enterprise Integration Patterns;
  • Boa capacidade de planejamento, organização e documentação;

Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. A gente se dedica muito em ser uma das melhores e mais inovadoras empresas para se trabalhar do país, possibilitando experiências e carreiras incríveis para nossas pessoas. Nossa forte abordagem de pessoas em primeiro lugar é reconhecida externamente por meio de diversas certificações de mercado: fomos premiados pelo Great Place To Work em 24 países e pela certificação internacional Top Employers, além de sermos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para jovens profissionais e contarmos com uma avaliação de 4,6 no Glassdoor. Most of our sites and services are written in C# / ASP.NET and new services are written in .NET Core. New applications use vue.js or Angular in the front-end while older ones use server-rendered (Razor) views in combination with jQuery. Microsoft Orleans enables our scalable and robust distributed applications. MS SQL Server is used for most of our storage needs, but also Redis and ElasticSearch are used when it makes sense to do so. RabbitMQ is our go-to message broker. We use Gitlab for code versioning and CI, and the Atlassian stack for tickets and documentation.

  • Proficient in C# and MVC.
  • Experience with Testing/Metrics Monitoring/Logging on a large scale distributed system.
  • Experience with Microservices architecture.

  • Good understanding of basic web technologies, such as HTTP, REST, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of algorithms and design patterns.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality code.

Nice to have:

We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Quality Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of the materials used in our products. Your expertise will contribute significantly to our mission of delivering exceptional IIoT solutions to industries worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the design and manufacturing teams to define quality standards, specifications, and inspection criteria for mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Conduct thorough quality assessments of incoming materials, ensuring they meet specified requirements and are free from defects.
  • Develop and implement quality control processes, including inspection plans, testing procedures, and relevant documentation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for any quality issues identified during testing or production, and track these actions to closure.
  • Participate in the design review process to provide insights on potential quality concerns and ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA).
  • Conduct regular audits of manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve component quality, resolve quality-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in the supply chain.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of quality assurance activities, including test results, inspection reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality documentation, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, and quality manuals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Quality Engineer, preferably in a manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity in quality tools, methodologies, and documentation such as 8D, DMAIC, NCR, EA, and statistical process control.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Reading and Writing English proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Experience with plastic injection and mold manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Reliability Engineering and its tools.
  • Spanish proficiency.

Compensation

Se você busca desafios, aprendizado contínuo e um ambiente que valoriza a inovação, essa pode ser a oportunidade certa para você!

  1. Estar presencialmente na estação de coleta. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, podendo incluir finais de semana e feriados.

  10. Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade.

title: Hardware Test Engineer - Mechanics
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What will you do

As a Hardware Test Engineer specializing in Mechanics, your primary role will involve conducting rigorous mechanical testing and validation on a variety of hardware products. You will be hands-on in the lab, applying principles of mechanics to assess durability, lifespan, and functionality, ensuring all mechanical components operate effectively under specified conditions and comply with all regulatory standards.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute detailed mechanical test plans, including stress tests, vibration tests, and thermal cycling to evaluate product endurance.
  • Use precision measuring instruments such as calipers, micrometers, and force gauges to gather accurate test data.
  • Simulate real-world mechanical stresses using test rigs, hydraulic actuators, and environmental chambers.
  • Analyze test results, identify mechanical failures, and collaborate with design engineers to recommend product improvements.
  • Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures, results, and insights for future reference and compliance purposes.
  • Ensure all mechanical testing equipment is calibrated, maintained, and operating correctly.
  • Stay up-to-date with the mechanical testing methodologies and industry best practices.
,

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a mechanical testing environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of mechanical systems, materials properties, and manufacturing processes.
  • Proficiency in CAD software, such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD, for reviewing mechanical designs.
  • Experience with scripting languages, like Python and MATLAB.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis software like Excel.
  • Familiarity with industry standards for mechanical testing and compliance.
,

Bonus Points

  • Advanced certifications in mechanical testing or material science.
  • Experience with automated testing systems and robotic testing equipment.
  • Fluent in English.

  • Competitive salary and stock options

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Character Art Director to join our growing team on Fortnite. This person will lead and collaborate with multidisciplinary artists to help create and maintain Epic's vision. This person will have a balance of creative thinking and a strong ability to lead a team in developing content for our various projects. By working closely with the Senior Art Director, you will be accountable for identifying and communicating a high-quality visual style, as well as developing a team of artists and coaching them to do the same.

In this role, you will

  • Be highly creative. Imagine and communicate your vision to the team to develop new content that players will love.
  • Lead Art initiatives, working closely with other non-Art Teams including Design, Engineering, Product, and Marketing.
  • Strategize with Senior Leadership to help define the Art Team's direction and priorities.
  • Create and iterate unique and stunning character designs within a determined production schedule.
  • Direct and mentor a worldwide team of artists; delivering effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.
  • Collaborate with the Product and IP teams on themes and cosmetic sets.
  • Deliver effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.

What we're looking for

  • Experience as an art director with a character design background and understanding of the 2D and 3D process in a game studio.
  • A deep understanding of the game development process and art disciplines.
  • Experience with working with Product Management on new initiatives.
  • Solid technical background in art and game development.
  • Practical experience using Unreal.
  • Strong leadership skills in order to lead a large number of people toward a singular vision.
  • Strong collaborative nature to partner with senior art directors and discipline leads.
  • Strong understanding of art fundamentals, multiple art styles, anatomy, appeal, color theory, and how color affects mood & focal points - with a focus on modern fashion-forward aesthetics.
  • Experience designing characters of a wide variety with broad appeal and the ability to adapt to and innovate new styles and techniques.
  • Experience directing and supporting artists across multiple disciplines.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, but it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

About the role

We are seeking a skilled and go-getter Sr. Machine Learning Engineer to join our Data Science team and play a pivotal role in driving the model development/production lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, MLOps, and DataOps teams to implement ML models for assessing transactional risk and fraud, enable automated model retraining, and support robust machine learning inference systems. This role is essential for ensuring efficient, reliable, and scalable workflows to power data-driven insights and machine learning solutions.


What you will do:

  • Model Development and Optimization: Design the data-architecture flow for the efficient implementation of real-time model endpoints and/or batch solutions.
  • Data Exploration and Feature Engineering: Engineer domain-specific features that can enhance model performance and robustness.
  • Productionization of ML Models: Build pipelines to deploy machine learning models in production with a focus on scalability and efficiency, and participate in and enforce the release management process for models and rules.
  • Monitoring, Maintenance & Improvement: Implement systems to monitor model performance, endpoints/feature health, and other business metrics; Create model-retraining pipelines to boost performance, based on monitoring metrics; Model recalibration.
  • Scalable System Design: Design and implement scalable architectures to support real-time/batch solutions; Optimize algorithms and workflows for latency, throughput, and resource efficiency; Ensure systems adhere to company standards for reliability and security.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Conduct research and prototypes to explore novel approaches in ML engineering for addressing emerging risk/fraud patterns.
  • Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with fraud analysts, risk managers, and product teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS/Engineering/Data-Science or other technical disciplines.
  • Solid experience in DS/ML engineering.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing batch and real-time streaming pipelines, using SQL and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for data pipelines, streaming systems, and model performance.
  • Experience in AWS cloud services (Sagemaker, EC2, EMR, ECS/EKS, RDS, etc.).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and MLOps platforms like MLflow.
  • Experience with Machine Learning modeling, notably tree-based and boosting models supervised learning for imbalanced target scenarios.
  • Experience with Online Inference, APIs, and services that respond under tight time constraints.
  • Proficiency in English.

    • Prior experience with AWS Sagemaker and/or similar DS/ML workbench.
    • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Feature store development and integration experience.
    • Experience with distributed data systems such as Kafka, Spark, Hadoop, and workflow/data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow).

title: Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling
description:
Account Manager, Global Selling DSR (Direct Seller Recruiting), Amazon Global Selling

Are you looking for a challenging career in business-development? Do you have prior experience and a proven track-record in delivering against targets in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Amazon is looking for a Global Selling Account Managers to join its team based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Your role will be focused on contributing to new business acquisition (50% of the time) through hunting, specifically phone/email-based prospecting of new merchants who can bring their competitive range of products, pricing and availability to Amazon. You will also work with merchants as an account manager (50% of the time) – helping them to launch and grow their business on Amazon by ensuring they understand Amazon’s products, services, systems and tools. Lastly you will be responsible for using feedback from the merchants to identify opportunities to improve Amazon’s products, services, processes, systems and tools.
Key job responsibilities
- Identify, prospect and recruit high-potential merchants via phone or email
- Effectively prioritize and manage a pipeline of merchants to consistently meet/exceed quarterly targets
- Be a business partner for new merchants providing them with data-driven insights and advice to optimize their success on Amazon
- Work closely with new merchants, educating them about Amazon’s high standards of Delivery and Customer Experience
- Enable merchants to learn and master Amazon's tools and systems so they may become self-sufficient in managing their catalog, inventory and performance efficiently and to the required standards
- Learn and understand the specificities of your categories to spot trends, seasonal items and competitive pricing to best tailor your pitch and advice to merchants
- Track and report business development results, analyze, interpret reports and information for your portfolio of merchants
- Prioritize your time optimally to achieve your targets in a KPI-driven environment
A day in the life
A typical day begins with reviewing performance metrics and pipeline status before diving into proactive outreach to potential merchants. Throughout the morning, you'll conduct virtual meetings with new sellers, providing comprehensive onboarding support and guidance through Amazon's Seller Central platform. The afternoon focuses on analyzing merchant data, conducting business reviews, and offering strategic recommendations for growth. You'll continuously monitor category trends, evaluate competitive pricing, and ensure merchants maintain Amazon's high standards for delivery and customer experience. The day involves balancing reactive support with proactive business development, all while tracking progress against quarterly targets and updating necessary reports in the CRM system. Participation in external events may apply.
About the team
Our dynamic, multicultural team is dedicated to expanding Amazon's global marketplace by enabling merchants worldwide to reach international customers. Operating at the intersection of technology and international commerce, we help businesses navigate multiple marketplaces, local regulations, and cultural nuances. Our team combines diverse perspectives from professionals across different regions and languages, working together to break down cross-border selling barriers. We pride ourselves on our data-driven approach, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to merchant success. Join us in shaping the future of global e-commerce while maintaining Amazon's customer-centric focus.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience within e-commerce or Retail fields

description:
Why the American University of Iraq—Baghdad?

Opening its doors in January 2021, the new American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. This position will report directly to the Dean of the College of Dentistry .

Job Description

AUIB seeks a strategic, collaborative, values-driven leader to serve as the Associate Dean of the College of Dentistry. The Associate Dean will have an ambitious vision for AUIB Dentistry that harnesses talent, creativity, and diversity. The Associate Dean will support the dean, who is the administrative and educational head of the College of Dentistry.

This Position Will Be Responsible For

  • Recruiting and retaining the college’s clinical faculty and staff in response to programmatic needs and encouraging their professional development.
  • In consultation with the chairs and directors of the concerned departments and divisions and appropriate committees, as specified in the policies, recommend to the college dean the appointment, tenure, promotion, retention, sabbatical leave, annual salary increase and retirement actions of any faculty member and administrative officer of the college.
  • Developing the clinical component of the college’s curriculum of the College.
  • Developing clinical continuing education and post-graduate programs to develop the advanced skills of practicing dentists.
  • Securing, in consultation with the Dean, the necessary accreditation and regulatory affairs associated with the profession and practice of dentistry.
  • Establishing the necessary academic quality assurance system within the college in line with those of the university as a whole leads to programmatic accreditation.
  • Overseeing, in consultation with the Dean, the appointment of academic staff and other technical and support staff of the College.
  • Representing, in the absence of the Dean, the College at meetings of the university, professional associations, governmental agencies, and other groups.
  • Developing the college’s practice and training facilities and creating an environment that facilitates research and scholarly activity.
  • Delegating duties to appropriate individuals or groups whenever indicated.
  • Performing additional tasks as the college dean or other suitable administrative officers of the university may specify.

Required Skills/Abilities

This position requires:

  • DDS, DMD, Ph.D., or the highest professional qualification in dentistry, and be a graduate of an accredited dental school.
  • Leadership experience in relevant academic institutions or universities for at least 10 years.
  • Evidence of academic and research innovations with a track record of scholarly and professional practice leadership in the field.
  • Demonstrated success in enhancing and advancing patient care, education, and research programs.
  • Demonstrated success in securing private, corporate, and/or governmental support to advance the college’s mission.
  • Demonstrated success in managing and leading a complex organization undergoing change.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to listen and understand the needs of faculty, staff, and students; and the ability to build strong relationships with internal and external constituents.
  • Effective decision-making and conflict resolution skills.
  • Solid understanding of dental clinical practice, procedures, and scheduling.
  • Demonstrated accomplishments in research and scholarship.
  • Operational understanding of American university educational systems.
  • Preferred experience working and living in the Middle East.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

You’ll use tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Kibana), and Octopus Deploy to monitor, troubleshoot, and manage IT operations and deployments.   • Hands-on handling and troubleshooting of a wide variety of support matters
  • Build internal knowledge base and document articles to improve internal incident management process
  • Speedily interpret and analyze data from various sources in a fast-moving and changing environment

What you bring

  • BSc or Academy degree in Information Technology or related field
  • At lease 1-2 years of experience in a production support environment
  • Prior experience in iGaming industry will be considered an asset
  • ITIL Foundation certified or equivalent experience working in an organization adopting ITIL best practices will be a strong asset
  • Experience working in an organization adopting Incident Management and IT operations best practices will be a strong asset
  • Microsoft certifications would be considered as an asset in this area
  • Nice to have experience with monitoring tools and applications such as Grafana, Zabbix, Prometheus, PRTG, Nagios and Kibana
  • Nice to have experience with ITSM tools like Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Opsgenie
  • Willingness to work both day and night shifts in a rotation
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Ability to efficiently solve problems and attention to detail
